name: create_event
description: Create a new event in a named calendar.

calendar_name.description: Name of the calendar to create the event in.

start.description: Event start as ISO 8601. A bare datetime (e.g. 2026-09-28T21:00:00) is interpreted in the selected timezone; an offset datetime (e.g. 2026-09-28T21:00:00+03:00) is converted to it. A date (e.g. 2026-09-28) creates an all-day event.

end.description: Event end as ISO 8601, using the same form as start. For all-day events the end date is exclusive: a one-day event on 2026-09-28 has end 2026-09-29. Passed through unchanged.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone name (e.g. Europe/Athens) overriding the configured default_timezone for bare datetimes.

description.description: Optional longer description of the event.
